content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the alytus district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property between the applicant and the defendant the defendant objected to the division of assets but the court granted the applicants claim in full the defendant was awarded a tworoom apartment and a renault megane vehicle as personal property the applicant was awarded financial compensation of eur 15000 for their share of the apartment the court also recognized the defendants personal debts to creditors the applicant requested the dissolution of their marriage and certain property rights including the apartment and car the applicant also wanted to retain their surname and asked the defendant to pay the costs of the proceedings the court ordered the defendant to pay the plaintiffs legal costs and recognized the defendants debts as personal debts the court also ordered the applicant to pay the defendants legal costs and the state to pay the defendants costs for serving procedural documents
